description: {"time": 1783112246462, "blocks": [{"id": "ju97a0yclo", "data": {"text": "Steel Pulse \u2014 named after the legendary British reggae band \u2014 brought roots, rock, and reggae to ROG Sacco's fleet. Dennis Muraguri's 2017 woodcut captures the band's name in bold lettering with the matatu's distinctive graphic framing. ROG Sacco operates routes that connect Nairobi's residential areas, and their fleet is known for music-themed designs that reflect the tastes of their drivers and owners. Steel Pulse was more than a name \u2014 it was a statement of allegiance to reggae culture and its messages of unity and resistance.
